analysis:
At a press interaction on 28 September 2012, Rural Development and Sanitation Minister Jairam Ramesh said India would be free of open defecation within ten years, i.e. by about 2022, under Nirmal Bharat Abhiyan (the successor to the Total Sanitation Campaign).

Census 2011, the most recent census available at the time, recorded that 53.1% of all households and 69.3% of rural households had no latrine within their premises. Times of India reported the ministry's target of making every gram panchayat open-defecation free within ten years.

Independent studies of the period found that increases in toilet construction did not translate into use at scale. The ten-year deadline fell outside the INC/UPA period, and the goal was not reached by 2022 according to later national surveys and peer-reviewed analyses.
